name: Omae no Kaa-chan, Ii Onna Da yo na.
original_name: お前の母ちゃん、良い女だよな。
source:
Mokoto's mother Ryouko is as hot as even his classmates often say that to you.
The same is true for your close friend Hiroki's mother Aiko.

While talking with Hiroki about their mothers, they reach an agreement that 
they will get laid with each other's mother. The sultry summer with 
the mothers' sweats and breathes promiscuously scattering begins.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233486.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
真琴的母亲凉子火辣得连他的同学都经常对他说：“你妈妈真是个好女人。”

你亲密朋友广树的母亲爱子也一样。

两人谈起各自的母亲后达成协议：他们要分别和对方的母亲上床。

伴随着母亲们的汗水与气息、肆意四散的淫靡夏日就此开始。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233486.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
